name: Enchanted Well reduces Moonwell Splash's cast time by 0.3 sec (#1194)
contract: Enchanted Well 680820 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, passive) effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), EffectBasePoints -301 with DieSides 1 -> -300 ms, EffectSpellClassMask word1 0x8. Moonwell Splash ranks 1-12 (800370, 503019-503029) carry SpellFamilyFlags word1 0x8 and CastingTimeIndex 19 (SpellCastTimes.dbc row 19 = 2500 ms), so the mask selects every rank; the tooltip is 'Reduces the cast time of Moonwell Splash by 0.3 sec.'. Native path: Player::ApplySpellMod adds the flat modifier inside SpellInfo::CalcCastTime before the haste multiplier. The module's own cast-time change for Moonwell Splash (AscensionStarcallerContracts.cpp:60, a -100% modifier on Eclipse 800386) needs the Eclipse aura, absent on both fixtures. The spell_cast_time_ms metric returns SpellInfo::CalcCastTime(player). Both fixtures are the same race, class and level with no ratings, so their cast-speed multipliers are identical. Expected: 2500 on the control, 2200 (-300) with the talent, on rank 12 (503029) and rank 1 (800370).
